details:
- CVE-2026-53784: resolve an absolute daemon path one component at a time
  with an O_NOFOLLOW dirfd per level so a planted symlink cannot steer the
  daemon CWD outside the module when "use chroot = no"
- CVE-2026-53791: require the direct peer to match the new "proxy protocol
  hosts" list before a PROXY protocol header is trusted, so a forged source
  address cannot bypass "hosts allow" and "hosts deny"
- CVE-2026-53803: route the log file, batch files, motd, early-input file,
  daemon lock file and rsyncd.conf through open_no_attacker_symlinks() so a
  planted symlink cannot redirect an ancillary open
- CVE-2026-70463: parse "auth users" with conf_strtok() so a comma-only entry
  containing a space keeps its deny rule instead of being split on whitespace
  and silently discarded
